content.short: HeLa is the first modular layer 1 blockchain powered by stablecoin for real-world adoption.
content.description: HeLa is a modular layer 1 blockchain powered by a stablecoin, designed to pursue real-world adoption. Its architecture emphasizes modularity and EVM compatibility, while delivering stable gas costs. The protocol also incorporates privacy-preserving features and a decentralized digital identity framework, aiming to empower users and developers with predictable fees, interoperable smart contracts, and a privacy-conscious account layer.
content.meta: HeLa is a modular L1 blockchain powered by a stablecoin, built with A*STAR IHPC for real-world adoption. Discover HeLa and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
